AVIATION — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Flight Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Instruments.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Instruments.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Flight Instruments.

2. When learning Aircraft Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Structures.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Structures.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Structures.

3. When learning Aircraft Propulsion, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Propulsion.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Propulsion.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Propulsion.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Propulsion.

4. When learning Navigation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Navigation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Navigation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Navigation.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Navigation.

5. When learning Hangar Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hangar Safety.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hangar Safety.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hangar Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Hangar Safety.

6. When learning Flight Controls, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Controls.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Controls.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Controls.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Flight Controls.

7. When learning Airfield Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airfield Safety.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Airfield Safety.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airfield Safety.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airfield Safety.

8. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

9. When learning Terminal Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Terminal Operations.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Terminal Operations.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Terminal Operations.

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

11. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

12. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.

13. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

14. When learning Ramp services, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ramp services.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Ramp services.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ramp services.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ramp services.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Flight Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Navigation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Terminal Operations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Ramp services and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Airfield Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Hangar Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
